decisions.reason: Unlike the 2018 launches that disappeared by 2019, this product stayed visible through the initial review period and fits the firm's core heat-exchanger component capabilities, so under aspiration-level reasoning it is more likely retained unless clear underperformance emerges.

This product also survived the early post-launch selection stage and appears closely aligned with the firm's established technical base, so with no direct failure signal the firm would likely keep it while allocating slack to more promising incremental innovations.
